title: Chapter 6999: I Must Try

Chapter 6999: I Must Try

Chapter 6999: I Must Try

“What do you mean?” Till Ancestor’s expression changed.

“Exactly as I said. No one can take the celestial source away, it will be here.” Li Qiye said.

“And if I insist on taking it away?” The gleam from Till Ancestor’s eyes could freeze this world.

“Only death awaits.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Is that a threat?” Till Ancestor didn’t relent.

“Let’s just talk it out.” Mo Xiangsheng smelled aggression in the air and wanted to stop it.

“It’s not a threat since that’s unnecessary. Killing ten immortals with one step is just a trivial matter.” Li Qiye sipped his tea before smiling.

“...” Mo Xiangsheng took a deep breath upon hearing this. A stronger immortal couldn’t easily kill weaker ones due to their durability.

“Bold words.” Till Ancestor’s face became ugly from the disdain.

“It’s understated. To be more exact, one step to kill one hundred immortals is expected.” Li Qiye smiled.

“...” Mo Xiangsheng stammered: “You-you’re joking, right?”

Not even celestial immortals could do this or they would have swept through Heavenrealm long ago. There wouldn’t be a need for alliances.

Such a being could definitely unite Heavenrealm or fight against the high heaven alone.

“These are the most arrogant words I’ve ever heard.” Till Ancestor sneered.

“Those are your feelings since an insect can’t know the power of a true dragon.” Li Qiye said.

“You!” Till Ancestor didn’t appreciate the verbal slap: “Then let me witness the power of a true dragon. Let’s see if you can match Skykiller True Dragon.”

“Should be able to.” Li Qiye smiled.

“?!” Mo Xiangsheng became slack-jawed: “A celestial immortal...”

“Feel free to try.” Li Qiye said.

“No, I’m good.” Mo Xiangsheng waved his hands repeatedly while moving back.

“I don’t buy it, make your move.” Till Ancestor wasn’t afraid.

Li Qiye placed his cup down and Ye Fantian filled it for him again.

“I’m afraid you won’t have the chance to fight if I start, you may go first.” Li Qiye said.

“You... Hahaha, very well, I will overestimate myself then.” He glared at Li Qiye.

“Gentlemen, we’re on the same side. Prosperity stems from harmony.” Mo Xiangsheng said: “Let’s just have a quick contest, nothing more.”

Till Ancestor ignored him and stared intensely at Li Qiye, who continued to drink tea.

“Spring Birth!” He derived a world full of life within his eyes. Anything outside would be sucked into this world and melt with it.

Those affected by this spell were subjugated to Till Ancestor’s reign since he was the creator. Mo Xiangsheng couldn’t move an inch, unable to control his fate.

Keep in mind that Till Ancestor’s target was Li Qiye alone. Nevertheless, his immortal power still affected those nearby.

“Senior, show mercy, don’t crush me!” Mo Xiangsheng shouted.

As the spell tried to suck Li Qiye into this world, Li Qiye finally glanced at the attacker.

“Boom!” The world crumbled instantly.
